body.name: paired-cell Assouad--Fano confidence-width handle
body.construction: Let \(T=T^{\mathrm{lb}}_{n,m}\), \(\delta=\delta_{n,m}\), \(S^{(0)}_{n,m}(y)=(3/4)y^{-4}\), and set \(S^{(1)}_{n,m}(y)=S^{(0)}_{n,m}(y)\) for \(y\le T\) and \(S^{(1)}_{n,m}(y)=(3/4)T^{-\delta}y^{-(4-\delta)}\) for \(y>T\). For each \(\omega\in\Omega_m\), construct \(P^{\mathrm{lb}}_{\omega}\) with the randomized \(X,A\) law of \(\mathrm{def{:}hall\text{-}class}\), all control survivals equal to \(S^{(0)}_{n,m}\), and, in pair \(j\), treatment survival \(S^{(1)}_{n,m}\) in cell \(2j-1\) when \(\omega_j=+1\) and in cell \(2j\) when \(\omega_j=-1\), with the other treatment survival equal to \(S^{(0)}_{n,m}\). Conditional on \(X\), take the two potential losses independent and set \(L=L(A)\). Pair \(P^{\mathrm{lb}}_{\omega}\) with \(\pi^{\mathrm{lb}}_{\omega}\), which treats exactly the sign-selected cell in every pair. Neighboring signs therefore change one \(m^{-1}\)-weighted component of the fixed policy mixture while leaving all observations below \(T\) identically distributed.
